title: Key transit routes
steps: Barcelona airport → Andorra la Vella (arrival): Direct Bus from T1 (07:30–23:00) or T2 (07:45–23:15), roughly every 2 hours, ≈3h30 to the Estació Nacional d'Autobusos. {{fact:direct-bus-31-50-eur}} (confirm current fare at booking). Runs 365 days a year; 24/25/31 Dec and 1 Jan schedules may vary.

Andorra la Vella → Barcelona airport (departure): Same route in reverse, first departure 06:15, last 22:15. Book online and arrive 30 min early. For a same-day flight, leave enough buffer for the ≈3h30 ride plus airport time — the last bus that reliably makes an evening flight is well before the 22:15 final departure.

Getting around Andorra la Vella: the Barri Antic, Casa de la Vall, Sant Esteve and most hotels sit within a 10–15 minute walk of each other and of the bus station. Cooperativa Interurbana Andorrana city buses (L1–L6, É, LC) connect the wider Andorra la Vella–Escaldes-Engordany conurbation for a small fare if you'd rather ride than walk to Caldea (L1: Caldea ↔ La Riberola).

To Llac d'Engolasters: no direct bus reaches the lakeside trailhead. Either taxi to the Ctra. d'Engolasters access road (≈15 min from Andorra la Vella) and walk the short lakeside path, or start the longer signed route from the Escaldes-Engordany tourist office on foot.

title: Weather
note: Early November in Andorra la Vella runs cold and damp — expect highs near 7°C, lows near -2°C, and a real chance of light snow at altitude. Pack layers and waterproof footwear.

title: Public holidays
note: Checked automatically against your travel dates. A national holiday can shorten hours or close shops, museums and the Casa de la Vall entirely — cross-check against the day plan before relying on a fixed opening time.
